name: Agent Board
description: A sidebar board: four columns for Cindy companions and Herdr agents, click to open a conversation or pane, with a color terminal, a command chat box, patrol schedules and standing policies.
whenToUse: Use it to see which agents and tasks are running, blocked, queued or idle, to set dispatch policy, analyse the board, or set up automation.

board_snapshot.description: Read companion status and the tasks of local projects, returning a board data snapshot.

board_state.description: Read the current board state and dispatch protocol: column ownership, tasks per agent, standing policy, patrol rules, last report and blocked pane digests. Call it before dispatching.

board_dispatch.description: Dispatch work to an agent on the board. targetKind=herdr uses a paneId; targetKind=cindy uses a companion id. Only dispatch to idle or queued entries, one verifiable item at a time.

board_open.description: Open the target behind a board card: kind=companion opens the companion conversation, kind=task opens the task, kind=pane focuses a Herdr pane.

board_policy.description: Read or save the standing policy, patrol rules and interface preferences. The policy is passed to every agent that reads board_state.

board_report.description: Write the judgement basis of a patrol round: overall verdict, blocked and queued lists, reasons, and blocked target ids (refs, used for de-duplication).

board_pick_model.description: Open the model picker and return the route the user selected, for analysis and automation.

board_analyze.description: Read the current board state and standing policy with the chosen model, and return an overall judgement plus up to three suggestions.

board_automate.description: Turn a plain-language goal into an automation prompt and open the pre-filled automation panel for the owner to save.

board_pane_read.description: Read the recent screen of a Herdr pane (ANSI colours preserved) to diagnose a blockage.

board_pane_action.description: Act on a Herdr pane: send types text, keys sends keystrokes, interrupt sends Ctrl+C. Never perform privilege escalation, sandbox bypass or outbound publication on the owner's behalf.

board_schedule_get.description: Read the current state of the board patrol automation: frequency, next fire time, and whether it is paused.

board_schedule_apply.description: Apply a patrol schedule: every N minutes/hours, daily, or weekly with selectable weekdays and a time, plus an on/off switch. Edits the Cindy automation directly.

board_chat.description: The chat box at the bottom of the board: the owner gives an instruction and the commander agent reads the board, dispatches work or changes policy, then replies. Returns history only when text is empty.
